title: 第242章 父亲的信第241章 琉璃灯
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
而这一刻，林恩再一次地感受到了这世间的奇妙。
或者说，和她们这对姐妹的相遇，是不是也是出自于容器家族之间的那种极其特殊的吸引呢？因为如果她们全都遗传自她们母亲的血统的话，那么这也就意味着，他在初次降临时遇到的这个女孩，其实也是红月家族的一员。
这还真的是奇妙的邂逅啊，或者说从一开始，他和她们之间的命运就被深深地绑定了。
“小妹妹，你叫什么名字呀？”
一路走在回她们家的路上，林恩望着身边的那个盲眼小萝莉，语气柔和地询问道。
“我听花耶说起过你，不过一直都没有机会见面，我只知道她有一个非常有爱的小姐姐~！”
那个齐刘海的女孩抓着花耶的手，脸上蒙着纱带，下意识低头，文静而贤淑的样子。
“我叫琉璃音，姓幽织，不过因为一直担任着侦查和预警的工作，所以大家都叫我琉璃灯，比……比花耶年龄要大一点点。”
她乖巧地就像是在汇报。
显然，因为驱魔师中养成的上下级的观念，她还是感觉到有些局促。
毕竟她也没想到花耶的那个朋友，居然会是……会是女武神陛下的神选，因为在第一次听到关于花耶身边的那个男人的消息时，她还以为是花耶遇到了变态暴露狂萝莉控的绑票，但谁能想到，就在当天下午，他的身份就在驱魔队当中沸沸扬扬地流传了开来。
原来那个时候他们队长遇到的，居然会是这样一个大人物。
林恩（～￣▽￣）～道：
“是吗？你真可爱！”
而且不知道为什么，总感觉对这个小萝莉有一种很亲近的感觉呢，就像是曾经在一张床上睡过一样，真的是一种匪夷所思的奇妙感触呢。
难道自己真的是萝莉控？
花耶顿时一盯。
“唔。”
脸蛋鼓了起来。
这种痴汉一样的语气真的是让人非常的不爽诶！

因为小琉璃可是人家的姐姐呢，不要随便看别人一眼就夸别人可爱啊，花耶明明比姐姐更可爱的啊！
无视掉花耶，林恩则仔细地观察着那个女孩的神态举止，她确实和花耶有那么一些相像，或者说他们都继承了她们母亲红月家的基因，只是和花耶不同的是，在她脸上还是隐约能够看到那个男人的影子。
而这也进一步地印证了他的猜测，其实她才是红月家族的那个女人和幽织琉司所诞下的后代，而花耶……则只传承于她的母亲。
而林恩之所以找她的原因也很简单。
如果幽织琉司真的深爱着她死去的妻子的话，那这个由他们真正结合所生下来的女儿，绝对能够在这场战争中发挥出重要的作用，除非他真的已经毫不顾忌到，连他唯一的亲女也不管不顾的地步。
只说他还没有决定，要不要利用她……来引那个家伙出现。
“对了，是……是我父亲出什么事了吗？”
琉璃灯茫然地抬起了头，疑惑转向了身边的林恩。
“为什么要突然……突然去我家里呢？”
她下意识抓紧了花耶的手。
显然这件事情她也是非常在意的。
而花耶也瞪着眼，抬头望着林恩，有些欲言又止，虽然她不太清楚到底发生了什么，但是从今天早上林恩他急冲冲地出去，而在回来之后还带着那个看上去很厉害的女人，这无论怎么看都不太像是什么事情都没有发生。
“没事，不用紧张。”
林恩柔和地安抚了她的情绪，道：
“只是教会内部需要对一些高阶能力者进行调查，包括很多的贵族和镇魔团的人，放心，只是例行公务，如果没什么问题的话，我们很快就会走。”
琉璃灯张了张嘴，想要说些什么，但最终还是点了点头。
终于。
一路穿过城区，他们在那座高耸而庞大的城堡前停了下来。
林恩抬起头，眺望着那座孤零零地屹立在此地的古堡，而上一次来这里，还是花耶偷偷地把他带回家，而这也是他第一次在这个世界过夜的地方。
“神选大人，你们稍等，我去开门！”

琉璃灯提着裙子，飞快地便向着大门的方向跑去。
content_en:
At this moment, Lin En once again felt the wonder of this world.
In other words, is the encounter with these two sisters also due to the extremely special attraction between the Container family? Because if they all inherited their mother's blood, then this also meant that the girl he met when he first came was actually a member of the Red Moon family.
This is really a wonderful encounter, or in other words, the fate between him and them has been deeply bound from the beginning.
"Little sister, what's your name?"
While walking back to their home, Lin En looked at the blind little loli beside him and asked in a soft tone.
"I heard Hua Ye talk about you, but I never had the chance to meet her. I only know that she has a very loving little sister~!"
The girl with straight bangs held Hua Ye's hand, her face covered with gauze, she lowered her head subconsciously, looking quiet and virtuous.
"My name is Liuliyin, and my surname is Youzhi. However, because I have been in charge of investigation and early warning, everyone calls me Liuliden. I am a little older than...Bihuaye."
She behaved as if she was reporting.
Obviously, she still felt a little awkward because of the concept of superiority and inferiority developed in the exorcist.
After all, she didn't expect that Huaye's friend would actually be... the divine choice of Her Majesty the Valkyrie, because when she first heard the news about the man next to Huaye, she thought Huaye had been kidnapped by a perverted exhibitionist lolicon. But who would have thought that in the afternoon, his identity would be widely circulated among the exorcist team.
It turned out that what their captain met at that time was actually such a big shot.
Lin En (~￣▽￣)~ said:
"Really? You're so cute!"
And I don’t know why, but I always feel that I am very close to this little loli, as if I have slept on the same bed before. It is really an incredible and wonderful feeling.
Could it be that I am really a lolicon?
Huaye immediately stared.
"Hmm."
His cheeks puffed up.
This idiot-like tone is really annoying!
Because Xiao Liuli is someone else’s older sister. Don’t just look at others and call them cute. Huaye is obviously cuter than her elder sister!
Ignoring Huaye, Lin En carefully observed the girl's demeanor. She did have some similarities with Huaye, or they both inherited the genes of their mother's Hongyue family. However, unlike Huaye, the shadow of the man could still be vaguely seen on her face.
And this further confirmed his guess. In fact, she was the offspring of the woman from the Hongyue family and Yuori Ryuji, while Hanaya... was only inherited from her mother.
And the reason why Lin En came to find her was also very simple.
If Yuori Ryuji really loved her dead wife, then this daughter born from their true union would definitely play an important role in this war, unless he really didn't care enough to even care about his only biological daughter.
He just said that he hadn't decided yet whether to use her... to lure that guy to show up.
"By the way, it's...did something happen to my father?"
Liuli Deng raised his head blankly and turned to Lin En next to him with doubts.
"Why do you have to go to my house suddenly... suddenly?"
She subconsciously grabbed Huaye's hand.
Obviously she cares about this matter very much.
Hua Ye also stared and looked up at Lin En, hesitating to speak. Although she didn't know exactly what happened, but since Lin En rushed out this morning and came back with that powerful-looking woman, it doesn't look like nothing happened.
"It's okay, don't be nervous."
Lynn said softlyHe soothed her emotions and said:
"It's just that the church needs to investigate some high-level ability users, including many nobles and people from the Demon Suppression Group. Don't worry, it's just a routine matter. If there are no problems, we will leave soon."
Liuli Deng opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but finally nodded.
finally.
All the way through the city, they stopped in front of the towering and huge castle.
Lin raised his head and looked at the old castle standing alone here. The last time he came here, Hua Ye secretly took him home, and this was also the place where he spent the night in this world for the first time.
"Sir Chosen God, please wait a moment, I'll open the door!"
Liuli Deng held up her skirt and ran quickly towards the door.
